title: Observability Engineer
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Observability Engineer: Build telemetry systems with metrics, logs, traces, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, alerting, SLOs, and incident insights.

tree.name: Foundations and Role Context
tree.description: Understand what Observability Engineer work looks like, which problems it solves, and the baseline concepts needed before building.

children.name: Domain Basics
children.description: Learn the vocabulary, workflows, constraints, and decision-making patterns used by practitioners in this role.

children.name: Tooling and Daily Workflow
children.description: Set up the core tools, local environment, version control habits, debugging workflow, and documentation style.

tree.name: Core Skills and Implementation
tree.description: Build the practical skill stack for Observability Engineer through small exercises, realistic constraints, and repeatable workflows.

children.description: Practice common patterns, tradeoffs, reusable structures, naming, configuration, and problem decomposition.

children.description: Work with issues, pull requests, release notes, stakeholder demos, decision records, and measurable acceptance criteria.

tree.name: Portfolio and Career Readiness
tree.description: Turn your Observability Engineer learning into proof: case studies, GitHub artifacts, demos, interview stories, and clear role positioning.

children.name: Case Study Writing
children.description: Write a concise case study with problem, constraints, decisions, implementation, validation, outcomes, and next improvements.

children.name: Project: Observability Engineer Portfolio Capstone
children.description: Build a portfolio-grade Observability Engineer project with a README, diagrams or screenshots, tests/checks, deployment or demo notes, and a lessons-learned section.
